(() => { const s = game.scene.getScene('Level'); const e = s.enemies.getChildren()[0]; s.player.setPosition(e.x - 28, e.y); s.player.facing = 1; return JSON.stringify({type: e.texture.key, mode: e.mode}); })()
(() => { const s = game.scene.getScene('Level'); const e = s.enemies.getChildren()[0]; return JSON.stringify({type: e.texture.key, modeAfterScratch: e.mode}); })()
(() => { const s = game.scene.getScene('Level'); const e = s.enemies.getChildren()[0]; return 'rat 3.5s later (should stay ko): ' + e.mode; })()

(() => { const s = game.scene.getScene('Level'); const e = s.enemies.getChildren()[2]; s.player.setPosition(e.x - 28, e.y); s.player.facing = 1; return JSON.stringify({type: e.texture.key, mode: e.mode}); })()
(() => { const s = game.scene.getScene('Level'); const e = s.enemies.getChildren()[2]; return JSON.stringify({type: e.texture.key, modeAfterScratch: e.mode}); })()

(async () => { const s = game.scene.getScene('Level'); const e = s.enemies.getChildren()[2]; const t0 = performance.now(); while (e.mode === 'ko' && performance.now() - t0 < 6000) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 50)); return JSON.stringify({mode: e.mode, secondsDown: Math.round((performance.now() - t0) / 100) / 10}); })()
(() => { const s = game.scene.getScene('Level'); const e = s.enemies.getChildren()[3]; s.player.setPosition(e.x, e.y); return 'moved into awake raccoon'; })()
(() => { const s = game.scene.getScene('Level'); return JSON.stringify({hp: s.player.hp}); })()

(async () => { const s = game.scene.getScene('Level'); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { const e = s.enemies.getChildren().find(x => x.mode === 'patrol'); if (!e) break; s.player.invulnUntil = 0; s.player.setPosition(e.x, e.y); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 150)); } return JSON.stringify({hp: s.player.hp, ending: s.ending}); })()
(() => { const s = game.scene.getScene('Level'); return JSON.stringify({restartedHp: s.player.hp, ending: s.ending, x: Math.round(s.player.x)}); })()
